rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading the page text layer with pdfplumber; the pages are born-digital
rows.proof:
The FY2014 general fund appropriations, pages 24-28. Read from the TEXT LAYER -- these pages carry their own words, so no image was involved. The five money columns are measured on each page, because every page of the run sits at a different offset: appropriated ends at x=296 on p24 and x=254 on p26, and a fixed layout would file each page one column out.
TWO IDENTITIES, BOTH CLOSING: every department returns available less expended less encumbered as its balance to revenue, 51 of 51 that print all four; and all FIVE columns sum across the five pages to the printed GRAND TOTAL -- 31,356,354.04 appropriated and available, 30,955,803.56 expended, 233,181.84 encumbered, 167,368.64 balance.
A FORWARD PRINTED ON ITS OWN LINE is counted only when the department below it has NOT folded it into its own appropriated, which the page says by whether that department’s appropriated equals its available. Three such lines appear -- 8,118 above Legal Expenses and 6,150 above Total Insurance are already inside their department totals; 4,000 above Mtc of Town Radios is not, and its available exceeds its appropriated by exactly that. Without the rule the appropriated column is 14,268 out and the other four still tie.
Six rows are LINES of State & County Assessments, not departments: their own unlabelled subtotal follows them.
